insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Benefit policy for women: lump-sum on diagnosis of listed illnesses. 90 / 180-day waiting per illness; 1-year waiting for pregnancy complications and newborn complications; 3-year PED waiting; 7-day survival period.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: 41 listed critical illnesses/procedures plus women-specific cancers, major illness, surgical procedures, cardiac procedures.
critical_illness_cover.notes: Includes breast/cervical/uterus/fallopian/ovary/vagina cancers, SLE with lupus nephritis, rheumatoid arthritis, severe osteoporosis, Wertheim's operation, radical vulvectomy, hysterectomy, open CABG, heart valve repair, MI, coma, stroke, balloon valvotomy, pacemaker, angioplasty plus 41-CI list.

maternity_coverage.notes: Pregnancy complications optional cover: DIC, ectopic, molar, eclampsia. Entry age for pregnancy cover 18-40.

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn complications cover: Down syndrome, spina bifida, tetralogy of Fallot, cleft palate, VSD, PDA, surgical separation of conjoined twins.

notable_exclusions_summary: Women-specific critical illness benefit policy covering cancers, major illness, surgical procedures, cardiac ailments, plus Assault & Burns injury cover, Loss of Job, Reduced Premium benefit on minor diagnosis. Survival period 7 days.
available_riders: Post Diagnosis Support (second opinion, gene expression profiling)
